RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may possess up to 3 ounces of marijuana.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/business-professionals/cannabis-regulation/adult-use-faqs.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Missouri?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: A consumer may purchase up to 3 ounces in a single transaction, and be lawfully in possession of up to 3 ounces of dried, processed marijuana or its equivalent.

RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_quote: Adults 21 and older may buy adult-use marijuana at a licensed dispensary.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/business-professionals/cannabis-regulation/adult-use-faqs.
RECREATIONAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for adults to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Missouri?
RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_section: Consumers will be required to present a valid government issued photo ID when purchasing adult use products at a dispensary.

RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_quote: Individuals at least twenty-one years of age may obtain a consumer personal cultivation card from the department to cultivate up to six (6) flowering marijuana plants, six (6) nonflowering plants under 14 inches tall or more, and six (6) non flowering plants under 14 inches tall in a single enclosed locked facility. All consumer personal cultivation must take place at a private residence.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/safety/cannabis/patient-cultivation.php.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for adults to grow cannabis in the state of Missouri?
RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_section: Individuals at least twenty-one years of age may obtain a consumer personal cultivation card from the department to cultivate up to six (6) flowering marijuana plants, six (6) nonflowering plants under 14 inches tall or more, and six (6) non flowering plants under 14 inches tall in a single enclosed locked facility. All consumer personal cultivation must take place at a private residence.

RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_quote: No. Per Article XIV sections 1 and 2, no qualifying patient or consumer shall consume marijuana in a public place, unless otherwise provided by law. Local governments may designate areas for public consumption. Please check with your local government if this is applicable.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/safety/cannabis/faqs-general.php.
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.question: Is it legal to consume cannabis in parks, on sidewalks, or similar outdoor public spaces in the state of Missouri?
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_section: No. Per Article XIV sections 1 and 2, no qualifying patient or consumer shall consume marijuana in a public place, unless otherwise provided by law. Local governments may designate areas for public consumption. Please check with your local government if this is applicable.

RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_quote: No. Per Article XIV sections 1 and 2, no qualifying patient or consumer shall consume marijuana in a public place, unless otherwise provided by law. RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.question: Is it legal for public businesses such as cafes, bars, or conference centers to allow on-site cannabis consumption in the state of Missouri?
RECREATIONAL_ONSITE.gov_section: No. Per Article XIV sections 1 and 2, no qualifying patient or consumer shall consume marijuana in a public place, unless otherwise provided by law. Local governments may designate areas for public consumption. Please check with your local government if this is applicable.

MEDICAL.gov_quote: A patient ID card holder, or caregiver ID card holder on behalf of a licensed patient, may be in possession of up to a 60-day supply (12 ounces, unless the patient has a physician or nurse practitioner certification authorizing more than 6 ounces in 30 days).
MEDICAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/safety/cannabis/faqs-patient.php.
MEDICAL.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to possess cannabis in the state of Missouri?
MEDICAL.gov_section: A patient ID card holder, or caregiver ID card holder on behalf of a licensed patient, may be in possession of up to a 60-day supply (12 ounces, unless the patient has a physician or nurse practitioner certification authorizing more than 6 ounces in 30 days).

MEDICAL_STORE.gov_quote: Only Department-licensed dispensaries are legally authorized to sell medical marijuana in Missouri.
MEDICAL_STORE.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://health.mo.gov/citizens/cannabis-patient-services.
MEDICAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for medical marijuana patients to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Missouri?
MEDICAL_STORE.gov_section: The Department is alerting approved patient ID card holders that only Department-licensed dispensaries are legally authorized to sell medical marijuana in the state of Missouri.

MEDICAL_GROW.gov_quote: Licensed patients may obtain a cultivation card to grow up to six flowering marijuana plants.
